# H&M Junk Removal & Landscaping

> Student-run junk removal and yard work crew based in Herndon, Virginia, serving Fairfax and Loudoun counties (Herndon, Reston, Vienna, Oakton, Oak Hill, Fairfax, Chantilly, Centreville, Great Falls, McLean, Sterling, Ashburn). Customers text photos to 202-999-7885 and get one flat price for the job back by text.

- Phone and text: 202-999-7885
- Hours: 8 AM to 8 PM, every day
- Owner: Miles Dickey
- Quotes: free, by the job, from photos
- Google reviews: https://maps.google.com/?cid=7233374597949165858
